# Marked

`marked.js` comes from the installed `marked` package, version 18.0.11, file `lib/marked.esm.js`.
Upstream: https://github.com/markedjs/marked
License: `marked-LICENSE` (MIT).

The reader uses its lexer and constructs DOM nodes in `../markdown.js`. It does not insert exported HTML into the page.

KaTeX 0.19.0：来自 npm katex 的 dist/katex.mjs，按 MIT 许可本地分发（katex-LICENSE）。用于 MathML 公式输出。
